configurations.name: web-dev
runtimeArgs: N=lab-web-preview; docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; trap 'docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 143' INT TERM HUP; docker compose run --rm -T --name $N -p "127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3100}:3000" -w /workspace/web web sh -c 'make install && make dev' & wait $!

configurations.name: web-prod
runtimeArgs: N=lab-web-prod-preview; docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; trap 'docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 143' INT TERM HUP; docker compose run --rm -T --name $N -p "127.0.0.1:${PORT:-3101}:3000" -e SITE_URL -w /workspace/web web sh -c 'make install && make build && make start' & wait $!

configurations.name: storybook-dev
runtimeArgs: N=lab-storybook-dev-preview; docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; trap 'docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 143' INT TERM HUP; docker compose run --rm -T --name $N -p "127.0.0.1:${PORT:-6106}:6006" -e "HMR_CLIENT_PORT=${PORT:-6106}" -w /workspace/web web sh -c 'make install && make storybook' & wait $!

configurations.name: storybook-prod
runtimeArgs: N=lab-storybook-prod-preview; docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; trap 'docker rm -f $N >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 143' INT TERM HUP; docker compose run --rm -T --name $N -p "127.0.0.1:${PORT:-6107}:6006" -w /workspace/web web sh -c 'make install && make build-storybook && make preview-storybook' & wait $!
